pitch: You walk into a casino that never closes and never takes a dime you didn't choose to spend. Six machines with their own math and moods, a wheel that pays daily, missions that reset at midnight, and card albums worth chasing. Coins are the whole economy - and they are never real money.

pillars.title: Six machines, six moods
pillars.body: A confetti classic, an Egyptian high-roller, cascading dragons, candy wilds, a vintage one-armed bandit with pickable paylines, and a cyberpunk heist where wilds go viral. Each has its own verified math.
pillars.alt: Two miniature golden slot machines side by side with colorful reels.

pillars.title: Something every day
pillars.body: A free bonus wheel every 24 hours that pays more the longer your streak runs, three fresh missions a day, a gift every four hours, and card albums that end in a permanent golden frame.
pillars.alt: A colorful prize wheel with a red and gold jeweled base.

pillars.title: Coins, never cash
pillars.body: Coins are virtual, full stop. They cannot be withdrawn, redeemed, or turned into anything outside the game. You can buy more if you want to - you never have to, and the game never pays out.
pillars.alt: A single golden coin embossed with a star.

support.responseTime: Replies usually within two days at goldenpartycasino@pacificfrontdesk.com. Include the player ID from Settings - the in-app Contact Us button fills it in for you.

faq.q: I bought coins and they didn't arrive.
faq.a: Force-quit and reopen the game - the balance is server-side and re-syncs on launch. If they are still missing, tap Restore Purchases in Settings, and if that fails, use Contact Us so your player ID comes attached, plus the receipt from Apple. Missing coins get granted manually.

faq.q: How do I keep my progress if I change phones?
faq.a: Sign in with Apple or Google in the game. Your balance, level, and albums live on the server tied to that sign-in, so signing in on the new phone brings everything back. A guest account without sign-in lives only on the device it was created on.

faq.q: Where do I find my player ID?
faq.a: Settings, on the player card at the top. Tap the ID to copy it. The Contact Us button puts it in the email subject automatically, which is the fastest path to help.
No. Golden Party Casino is a social casino: coins are virtual, have no cash value, and cannot be withdrawn, redeemed, or transferred. That is not fine print - it is the design.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Settings, Delete Account. It permanently erases your server data - balance, level, albums, everything. There is no grace period and nothing for you to email us about afterward, because nothing is left.

The game needs an internet connection - every spin is decided on the game server. Check your connection, then reopen the game. Very fast auto-spin sessions can briefly hit the rate limit; the game asks you to rest a minute and then resumes on its own.

faq.q: How do I get a refund?
faq.a: Coin packs are bought through Apple, so refunds are handled by Apple: request one at reportaproblem.apple.com, signed in with the Apple Account you paid with.

sections.heading: What this game collects
sections.body: Your game state - coin balance, level, missions, and card albums - lives on a game server so it can survive a new phone. There is no advertising SDK and no third-party analytics SDK in the app; the only analytics are the game's own server-side events about spins and purchases, used to tune the game.

sections.heading: Signing in
sections.body: Sign in with Apple or Google is optional and exists so your progress can follow you. The game receives a confirmation of who signed in and stores an anonymous player ID against it. It never sees your password and never posts anything on your behalf.

sections.heading: Purchases
sections.body: Coin packs are processed entirely by Apple. The game server receives an anonymized receipt to credit the coins and honor restores. The studio never sees your payment details.

sections.heading: Deleting everything, and reaching a human
sections.body: Settings, Delete Account permanently erases your server data in one step, no email required. For anything else, write to goldenpartycasino@pacificfrontdesk.com and the team that built the game will answer.

sections.heading: Technical data and display name
sections.body: If you set a display name, it is stored with your account. The server also keeps basic technical data such as device type and approximate region, used to run the service and prevent fraud. We do not sell personal information and do not use it for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can play as a guest without giving any personal details, change your display name in Settings, and delete your account and all its data with Delete Account in Settings. Depending on where you live you may have further rights, such as access or portability; email us and we will honor applicable requests.

sections.heading: Adults only
sections.body: The game features simulated gambling and is intended for adults, in line with its App Store age rating. It is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under that age. If you believe a minor has used the game, email us and we will delete the data.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: If this policy changes, this page and its date will be updated, and material changes will be highlighted in the game where practical. Golden Party Casino: Slots is published by Oleg Nochka.

sections.heading: Entertainment only - no gambling
sections.body: Golden Party Casino: Slots is a social casino game for entertainment. All coins, spins and prizes are virtual. Coins have no monetary value, cannot be exchanged for cash, goods or services, cannot be transferred between players, and cannot be won as real money. Success in the game does not imply future success at real-money gambling.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: The game features simulated gambling and is intended for adults, in line with its App Store age rating. By playing you confirm you meet the age requirement in your region.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: An account is created automatically for your device; you may link it with Sign in with Apple or Google to keep it across devices. You are responsible for activity on your account. Accounts involved in cheating, exploiting bugs, abusing other players or breaking these terms may be suspended or closed. You can delete your account at any time in Settings; deletion is permanent.

sections.heading: Virtual coins and purchases
sections.body: Coin packs are optional in-app purchases processed by Apple under the Apple Media Services Terms and Conditions. Prices are shown before purchase, and coins are delivered after Apple confirms the transaction. Except where the law requires otherwise, purchases of virtual coins are final; refund requests are handled by Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. Coin amounts, prices, features, odds presentation and bonuses may change.

sections.heading: Fair play
sections.body: You agree not to use bots, automation, exploits or unauthorized tools, not to interfere with the game servers, and not to reverse-engineer the app except where that restriction is prohibited by law. Outcomes are generated on the server by a random process, and game math may be adjusted between versions.

sections.body: The game, its art, names and software belong to us or our licensors. It is licensed to you, not sold, under Apple's standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement together with these terms, for personal entertainment only.

sections.heading: Disclaimers and liability
sections.body: The game is provided as it is, without warranties. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages, or for loss of virtual items, and our total liability for any claim is limited to what you paid in the twelve months before it. Nothing here limits rights you have under consumer law in your own country.

sections.heading: Responsible play
sections.body: The game is meant to be fun. If your play is becoming a problem, take a break or use Screen Time on your iPhone. If gambling in general is a concern, help is available from the National Council on Problem Gambling at ncpgambling.org or 1-800-GAMBLER.
